B's small extras (category labels, an explanatory note about roles) don't separate it from A in a meaningful way. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two answers are nearly identical: each shows the same three-theme screen with a matching light palette, a well-tuned dark theme with lighter greens and salmon reds, and a high-contrast theme with black borders, darker tones and +/- signs on every amount.
